name: AMOREPACIFIC Holdings Corp.
summary: AMOREPACIFIC Holdings Corp., through its subsidiaries, engages in manufacturing, marketing, and trading of manufacturing and manufacturing and selling cosmetics, and household goods in Korea, Asia, North America, and internationally. The company also offers hair and beauty products. In addition, it is involved in the food (tea) sales; growing and selling green tea; manufacturing and sales detergents, and organic and inorganic compounds; research and development; product packaging and facility management; and human resources management activities.
